owner_tightening.t1_no_fixed_three_column: 遵守：DP-15 比较 持续多栏 / 主会话+按需上下文 / 主会话全宽+专业 surface 三模型；只定信息层级与关系，未锁固定栏位/宽度/永久三列
owner_tightening.t2_queue_not_lock_sidebar: 遵守：DP-16 未锁左侧栏；Conversation Queue 确认为 primary work-entry surface 并受 Store Scope 过滤；placement 后续决定
owner_tightening.t3_ai_attaches_to_work_object: 遵守：DP-18 原则 AI output attaches to the work object it assists；未建立第二条独立 AI 聊天工作流；AI 管理入口属管理 IA
owner_tightening.t4_no_separate_professional_mode: 遵守：DP-19 未采用独立 professional mode；professional fallback continuously reachable（progressive disclosure + 快捷入口）；快捷键非唯一方式
owner_tightening.t5_dp21_inspectable_facts: 遵守：新增 DP-21/invariant I-4——AI-assisted decisions 必须可查看依据业务事实/来源，但不暴露 hidden chain-of-thought
owner_tightening.t6_queue_vs_conversation_state: 遵守：IA 文档明确区分 workspace queue state（待处理/未读/AI待审）与 active conversation state（Ownership/Store/Order/AI suggestion），未混为一类
owner_tightening.t7_progressive_disclosure_no_component_l: 遵守：DP-17 维持 inline facts -> context surface -> full professional view；未锁 drawer/right-panel/popover
owner_tightening.t8_supervisor_ops_independent: 遵守：DP-20 维持 Supervisor/Ops 独立 IA domain；Agent Workspace 仅少量 escalation/transfer entry，未嵌入 Supervisor console
owner_tightening.t9_no_code_change: 遵守：产品代码变更=0；未挂载 AI primitive；未实现 Phase 4 workflow；未锁 Product/Order 最终 UI
